exposure: Middle cerebral artery pulsatility index (MCA PI)
outcome: Adverse perinatal outcome (meconium stained liquor, meconium aspiration syndrome, perinatal asphyxia, cesarean section for suspected fetal distress, perinatal death)
cohort: 212 low-risk pregnant women beyond 40 weeks' gestational age
finding: Doppler CPR showed the highest diagnostic accuracy in predicting adverse perinatal outcomes in pregnant women after 40 weeks' gestation compared to UA PI, MCA PI, and NST.
